mod.overview: Tribes Hunters v1.4 (Tinman / 'Kidney Thief', February 2000, FlagHunter.cs) uses stock Base weapons and physics while banning Mortar, Mines, and Turrets ($FlagHunter::banList), auto-spawning players in Light Armor with Blaster/Chaingun/Disc/RepairKit, and replacing CTF with Greed/Hoard Nexus flag scoring.
notes: Bans & spawn gear (FlagHunter.cs): explicitly bans Mortar, MineAmmo (Mines), and TurretPack (Turrets) via $FlagHunter::banList[0..2]. Every player spawns directly in LightArmor carrying Blaster, Chaingun, DiscLauncher (equipped), and RepairKit.

Nexus scoring rules: every kill drops all carried flags plus one fresh flag ('yard sale' if >= 10), returning stacks to the Nexus scores escalating points, Greed mode requires holding at least $FlagHunter::GreedAmount (8) flags to cash in, and Hoard/Team Hunters toggles alter late-match rules.
Prevents heavy mortar spamming around the flag Nexus.
Prevents mining the Nexus turn-in pad.
Prevents turret defenses around the Nexus.
